name: GhostDatePickerContent
description: Anchored modal dialog positioned next to the input, with a Close control, error summary, polite status, and the calendar by default. After logical close it stays mounted with data-state="closed", inert, and pointer-events: none only while its own CSS exit transition or animation runs (useGhostPresence), then unmounts; focus, dismissal, scroll lock, and background inert release immediately.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the built-in Close control.

props.name: endDateInstruction
props.description: Polite instruction announced after the first range activation.

props.name: flip
props.description: Flip to the opposite side when overflowing.

props.name: offset
props.description: Distance or axis offsets between anchor and content.

props.name: placement
props.description: Preferred placement relative to the input (or trigger).

props.name: portal
props.description: Teleport through `GhostPortal` when `true`; render inline when `false`.

props.name: shift
props.description: Shift along the cross axis to stay in view.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Calendar and optional help/error content. Defaults to `GhostDatePickerCalendar`.

exposed.name: element
exposed.description: Mounted picker surface element while open or exiting; null once unmounted.

states.name: open
states.description: Applied on data-state while mounted and open.

states.name: closed
states.description: Applied on data-state while the surface plays its exit motion after logical close; the surface is also inert with inline pointer-events: none until it unmounts.
